metadata.name: Romanization of Greek -- UNGEGN 4.0 (transliteration)
notes: Transliteration version (reversible). Also appears in annex B of ISO 843:1997. Originates in v1.0 of UNGEGN transliteration, 1987. This likely was the intended system in ELOT 743:1982 for transliteration, but the reversible character diacritics are missing from the document, and the document does not indicate what there was supposed to be.

Diffed against the UN Romanization of Greek for Geographical Names (1987)
 table, transliteration version, as published in the WGRS Report on the Current
 Status of UN Romanization Systems for Geographical Names, version 4.0 (March
 2016) (eki.ee/wgrs/rom1_el.htm). The transliteration version differs from the
 transcription only by the sub-macron of source note 1: αυ av̱/af̱, γγ ṉg,
 γξ ṉx, γχ ṉch, ευ ev̱/ef̱, η i̱, ηυ i̱v̱/i̱f̱, ω o̱ — all encoded by the dependency
 elot-ell-Grek-Latn-743-1982-tl and verified.

Glyph variant, recorded not changed: the source prints the sub-macron as
 U+0320 (combining minus sign below); the map uses U+0331 (combining macron
 below), the conventional sub-macron character of the 1987 resolution.
